subject: Draw this scene: a planted bed of cattails at the water's edge. Tall straight green-and-tan cattail leaves and stems standing thick in shallow blue water, many dark brown sausage-shaped seed heads on tall stalks, and along the front of the bed a short low row of driven wooden stakes with a woven edging, showing it was planted by hand; open water and a far shore of dark trees behind, a pale sky.
